title: Introduction
description:
Welcome, traveler. I do not know your name, but neither do you mine. What matters is that we've met, talked... understood one another.
his world is full of wonders, but also danger. Many gears move in the clockwork of reality, and time is something nobody can escape. So the question is, what will you do with yours?
Within the contents of this book are a collection of people's notes, their journeys, and for some, their life's work. I'm certain it will prove useful to you.

objectives.name: Read The Book And Accept Responsibility of What Comes Next

description_completed:
This pouch, too, will be of use to you. And worry not if you wish to read the contents of this book. Its contents will always be accessible through your inventory.
Now, go forth, and carve your tale.
